scripts.postinstall: git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true; nuxt prepare
scripts.lint:skills: for s in .agents/skills/*/; do n=$(basename $s); [ "$(readlink .claude/skills/$n)" = ../../.agents/skills/$n ] || { echo "lint:skills: .claude/skills/$n must be a symlink to ../../.agents/skills/$n"; exit 1; }; done; for l in .claude/skills/*; do n=$(basename $l); [ "$(readlink $l)" = ../../.agents/skills/$n ] && [ -d $l/ ] || { echo "lint:skills: $l is not a symlink to an existing ../../.agents/skills/$n"; exit 1; }; done

validate-branch-name.errorMsg: Branch must be <type>/<kebab-slug>, e.g. feat/project-showcase (types: feat fix refactor chore docs test perf ci build style revert). Rename it with: git branch -m <type>/<slug>
